facts.fact_text: On 25 March 2011 a group of about seventy people gathered in front of the Viranşehir (district of Şanlıurfa) branch of the Peace and Democracy Party (the BDP, a pro-Kurdish political party).
On 25 March 2011 the group of about seventy people held a march in Viranşehir (district of Şanlıurfa).
The applicant was the Vice-President of the Şanlıurfa branch of the Peace and Democracy Party (the BDP, a pro-Kurdish political party).
The applicant delivered a speech to the demonstrators at the end of the march on 25 March 2011.

In his speech at the end of the march on 25 March 2011, the applicant said: 'We request that the persecutions happening in this country be ended, that our friends arrested in relation to the KCK [Koma Civakên Kurdistan – Kurdistan Communities Union] incident be released, that the electoral thresholds be lowered and that the teaching of our mother tongue [and] education in our mother tongue be guaranteed under the Constitution. We will continue this protest until our requests are granted. We will never kneel down...'
On 6 April 2011 the Viranşehir Chief Public Prosecutor's Office indicted the applicant in the Viranşehir Criminal Court of First Instance (the Criminal Court).
The applicant was indicted under section 28(1) of the Meetings and Demonstrations Act (Law no. 2911) for organising and participating in an unlawful demonstration.

On 17 November 2011 the Viranşehir Criminal Court of First Instance (the Criminal Court) convicted the applicant as charged under section 28(1) of the Meetings and Demonstrations Act (Law no. 2911) for organising and participating in an unlawful demonstration.
The applicant was indicted under section 28(1) of the Meetings and Demonstrations Act (Law no. 2911) for organising and participating in an unlawful demonstration.
The Viranşehir Criminal Court of First Instance (the Criminal Court) noted that the demonstration of 25 March 2011 had been held without the requisite prior notification.
The Viranşehir Criminal Court of First Instance (the Criminal Court) noted that the demonstration of 25 March 2011 had been held in contravention of the conditions provided for by the law.
The applicant was indicted under section 28(1) of the Meetings and Demonstrations Act (Law no. 2911) for organising and participating in an unlawful demonstration.
The Viranşehir Criminal Court of First Instance (the Criminal Court) noted that the demonstration of 25 March 2011 had been held without the requisite prior notification.
The Viranşehir Criminal Court of First Instance (the Criminal Court) noted that the demonstration of 25 March 2011 had been held in contravention of the conditions provided for by the law.
The Viranşehir Criminal Court of First Instance (the Criminal Court) sentenced the applicant to one year and three months' imprisonment.
